metaTitle: Digital Marketing Agency in Kansas City, MO | TDM
metaDescription: Digital marketing for Kansas City businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video for both sides of the state line.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Kansas City businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Kansas City is one metro in two states, with a Missouri core and large Kansas suburbs, and customers cross the line every day without thinking about it. We plan marketing that follows your customers across that line where you can serve them.

sections.heading: One metro, two states
paragraphs: The city of Kansas City is in Missouri, but a large part of the metro's households and offices are in Kansas: Overland Park, Olathe, Leawood, Lenexa and Kansas City, Kansas. On the Missouri side the suburbs include Lee's Summit, Independence, Blue Springs and Liberty, and the Northland covers everything above the Missouri River.

For marketing this has practical effects. People search with "MO" or "KS" in mind, and with suburb names more than the city name. Trades may need licences on both sides. Taxes and rules differ. A business should state plainly where it works, and its pages, business profile and ads should cover both states only if it truly serves both.
bullets: Area pages for the suburbs you serve on each side of the line.
Service areas and addresses in your Google Business Profile that match reality.
Ad targeting by drive time, with separate budgets for Johnson County and the Missouri side when results differ.
Reviews requested from customers in each area, since nearby reviews influence map rankings.
Reporting that shows which area and channel produced each lead.

sections.heading: What the Kansas City economy runs on
paragraphs: Kansas City has long been a crossroads for rail and road freight, and warehouses and distribution centres ring the metro. It is home to large engineering and construction firms, a well-known greeting card company, a national tax preparation firm, a regional Federal Reserve bank and a cluster of animal health companies. Healthcare systems and a growing technology community add to the mix.

Much of this is business-to-business. Engineering subcontractors, freight brokers, software vendors and specialist suppliers sell to buyers who shortlist online first. Their marketing depends on detailed service pages, search visibility for exact terms, and LinkedIn campaigns aimed at specific roles.

sections.heading: Districts with their own customers
paragraphs: Inside the city, each district draws a different crowd. The Country Club Plaza is the classic shopping and dining area. The Crossroads is full of galleries, studios, breweries and creative offices. The River Market has its weekend market and loft apartments, Westport is nightlife, and the Power and Light District serves downtown events. Brookside and Waldo are residential areas with loyal local shops, and 18th and Vine carries the city's jazz history.
A restaurant or shop should market to the people who actually come to its district, and say so by name. Visitors look for "near the Plaza" or "in the Crossroads", not for a street address.

sections.heading: Barbecue, game days and storm season
paragraphs: Kansas City is proud of its barbecue, and food here is a serious, competitive business that rewards good photography and video. Professional football and baseball shape the calendar: on game days much of the city wears red or blue, and bars, restaurants, retailers and caterers plan around the schedule. The American Royal brings a livestock show and a huge barbecue contest in the autumn.

Spring and early summer bring hail and severe storms, which create sudden demand for roofing, siding and car repair. Winters bring ice and furnace calls. Home service companies should have pages, ads and budgets prepared before the weather turns.

cards.heading: Kansas City businesses we can help

items.title: Restaurants and food brands
items.text: Barbecue joints, breweries and new concepts need strong visuals, active listings and campaigns tied to game days and events.

items.title: Home services
items.text: Roofing, HVAC, plumbing and remodelling firms need suburb pages on both sides of the line and call ads for storm days.

items.title: Logistics and distribution
items.text: Carriers, brokers and warehouses need sites that set out lanes, capacity and services for buyers comparing providers.

items.title: Engineering and construction
items.text: Firms and subcontractors win shortlists with project pages, clear capabilities and visibility for technical searches.

items.title: Health and animal health
items.text: Clinics, veterinary businesses and suppliers need accurate content and ad wording that follows platform rules.

items.title: Professional services
items.text: Law, accounting and financial firms compete on search for specific problems, with one clear page per service.

presence: TDM works with Kansas City businesses remotely. We do not have an office or a team member in the metro. Strategy, design, development and video are delivered online, with scheduled calls and written reports.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses on the Kansas side too?
faqs.a: Yes. We work remotely with businesses anywhere in the metro, in Missouri or Kansas. We do not have an office in Kansas City.

faqs.q: How do I show up in searches in both Kansas City, MO and Overland Park?
faqs.a: Create useful pages for each area you serve, keep your business profile's service area accurate, collect reviews from customers in both places and run ads targeted to each. A single page that mentions only Kansas City will rarely rank in the Kansas suburbs.

faqs.q: Should a local business advertise around game days?
faqs.a: If your trade benefits, yes. Bars, restaurants, caterers and retailers can plan offers and ads around the home schedule. Other businesses may find attention is elsewhere at those times and do better to shift budget to quieter days.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Kansas City?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope of work. We quote after a free consultation once we understand your goals.

faqs.q: How quickly can a campaign start?
faqs.a: That depends on your requirements and the brief. The timeline is agreed in the plan before work starts.
